35:4.text: , so were Messengers belied before you. And to Allâh return all matters

35:5.text: O mankind! Verily, the Promise of Allâh is true. So let not this present life deceive you, and let not the chief deceiver

35:6.text: is an enemy to you, so take
him as an enemy. He only invites his Hizb
that they may become the dwellers of the blazing Fire.

35:7.text: Those who disbelieve, theirs will be a severe torment; and those who believe
(in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
and do righteous good deeds, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward

35:8.text: Is he, then, to whom the evil of his deeds is made fair-seeming, so that he considers it as good
(equal to one who is rightly guided)
? Verily, Allâh sends astray whom He wills, and guides whom He wills. So destroy not yourself
in sorrow for them. Truly, Allâh is the All-Knower of what they do!

35:9.text: And it is Allâh Who sends the winds, so that they raise up the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land, and revive therewith the earth after its death. As such

35:10.text: , then to Allâh belong all honour, power and glory
[and one can get honour, power and glory only by obeying and worshipping Allâh (Alone)]
the goodly words, and the righteous deeds exalt it
(i.e. the goodly words are not accepted by Allâh unless and until they are followed by good deeds)
, but those who plot evils, theirs will be severe torment. And the plotting of such will perish.

35:11.text: (male and female discharge semen drops i.e. Adam’s offspring)
. And no female conceives or gives birth but with His Knowledge. And no aged man is granted a length of life nor is a part cut off from his life
Surely, that is easy for Allâh.
